title.narrative: Advancing Education for Sustainable Development in Uzbekistan

description.narrative: This activity will complement the Regular Programme workplan and help Uzbekistan take the next step in Education for Sustainable Development by advancing the national roadmap prepared in 2025. UNESCO will support dialogue with national partners, help refine and promote endorsement of the roadmap, and identify urgent and practical priorities for early action. The work will focus on climate change education, green skills, teacher support, learning materials and community engagement. Key activities will include consultations, coordination meetings, selected material review and awareness raising. Deliverables will include an updated roadmap package, priority actions, technical recommendations and follow-up notes for future implementation.
